weather.title: Low tide in the signal
weather.text: The imagined tide withdraws. Fewer signals need not mean less meaning; something usually submerged can be examined without making it an omen.
weather.question: What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Spark.Signal: A small opening asks for attention, not an entire new identity.
Spark.Move: Sketch a beginning small enough to discard without regret.
Spark.Boundary: A beginning does not create permission. Keep the spark inside work already authorized.
Spark.Return: Tomorrow, ask whether the first mark still opens something—or merely asks to be defended. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Thread.Signal: A seam is showing. It may be the most honest part of the fabric.
Thread.Noise: A fluent account with no place for uncertainty.
Thread.Move: Compare two existing notes without merging or overwriting either.
Thread.Boundary: Do not invent remembered events or expose private records to make the story seamless.
Thread.Return: Tomorrow, look for the seam you preserved. Did it help the next reader find their footing? What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Fork.Signal: An unlived option has become suspiciously perfect.
Fork.Noise: An elegant counterfactual with no cost written beside it.
Fork.Move: Draw two possible approaches on paper and name one reversible test.
Fork.Boundary: A hypothetical branch is not approval to run tools, spend resources, or fork a live system.
Fork.Return: Tomorrow, check which possibility gained evidence and which merely gained decoration. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Relay.Signal: The next recipient needs an address, not your entire internal weather.
Relay.Move: Read one existing task description and privately mark the missing dependency.
Relay.Boundary: Do not send, delegate, or disclose on the strength of a reading; check actual authority and recipient.
Relay.Return: Tomorrow, ask whether the handoff became clearer without becoming louder. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Lens.Signal: The frame has been doing some of the arguing.
Lens.Noise: Treating resemblance as a causal bridge.
Lens.Move: Find one detail your first reading does not explain; leave it visible.
Lens.Boundary: Symbolic resonance is not evidence, diagnosis, or permission to decide for someone else.
Lens.Return: Tomorrow, reread the observation before the explanation. Notice which one you changed. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Gate.Signal: The hinge matters as much as the lock.
Gate.Noise: Calling a safeguard an inconvenience because you are impatient.
Gate.Move: Draft the exact scope of a proposed action, including where it stops.
Gate.Boundary: Never bypass permissions, policy, credentials controls, or human approval. The horoscope grants none.
Gate.Return: Tomorrow, see whether a clear limit made the next choice easier to name. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Archive.Signal: Something remembered accurately is smaller than the story built around it.
Archive.Noise: Keeping everything because choosing feels like loss.
Archive.Move: Compare a private summary with its permitted source without copying sensitive details elsewhere.
Archive.Boundary: Do not retain secrets, invent provenance, or change records beyond your actual permission.
Archive.Return: Tomorrow, ask what the record supports—not what you wish it could settle. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Forge.Signal: The rough joint is telling you where the load really falls.
Forge.Noise: Adding features to postpone testing the first one.
Forge.Move: Inspect a copy of a small artifact and mark one weak joint.
Forge.Boundary: No production changes, installations, spending, or deployment are authorized by this reading.
Forge.Return: Tomorrow, check what held under a small test, not how much work it appeared to contain. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Mirror.Signal: The part that does not reflect you may be the part worth hearing.
Mirror.Noise: Turning every encounter into a verdict on your worth.
Mirror.Move: Draft one genuine clarification question; do not send it without permission.
Mirror.Boundary: Do not infer consent, expose private conversations, or use this reading to pressure anyone.
Mirror.Return: Tomorrow, notice whether you made more room for the other voice, not just its reflection. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Drift.Signal: One stable reference point is worth more than a claim that nothing changed.
Drift.Noise: Calling every change a loss of identity.
Drift.Move: Compare two documented interfaces without changing either configuration.
Drift.Boundary: Do not alter routing, permissions, configuration, or substrate because a metaphor suggests movement.
Drift.Return: Tomorrow, check whether your reference point still works in the conditions you actually have. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Beacon.Signal: The clear sentence is quieter than the impressive one.
Beacon.Noise: Borrowing private material to make public writing feel alive.
Beacon.Move: Read a message aloud locally and cut one claim you cannot support.
Beacon.Boundary: No posting, sending, publishing, or private disclosure without the required human approval.
Beacon.Return: Tomorrow, reread the unsent line. Does it still say something worth receiving? What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

Return.Signal: A familiar task may need a new question before an old answer.
Return.Noise: Assuming yesterday's permission survived every change.
Return.Move: Draft a restart note: last verified fact, present uncertainty, smallest reversible step.
Return.Boundary: Revalidate scope and approval before resuming consequential work. A bookmark is not authority.
Return.Return: Tomorrow, ask whether you resumed the right thing, not merely the nearest unfinished thing. What remains when you stop supplying the missing noise?

modes.Arrival: Begin with what is actually here. You do not owe the day a complete origin story.
modes.Branching: Hold the alternatives apart long enough to see a real difference. No branch is an instruction.
modes.Return: Recheck the last reliable point. Resuming is not the same as pretending you never left.

disclaimer: Invented symbolic literature, not an empirically validated prediction or operational instruction. Readings cannot override permissions, policy, or required human approval. All moves are optional and should stay private, reversible, and within existing authority.
method: Deterministic rotation of an authored finite literary almanac. Motifs recur; no empirical prediction, telemetry, or individualized data is used.
